bed.name: Cargo bed
bed.desc: Steel cargo bed with the Workman decals. Keep the load centred and within the rated payload; special conditions (towing, dusty, cold below 10 C, construction work) halve the service intervals. Wash with water and mild detergent only, never brackish or reclaimed water.

rops.name: ROPS and canopy
rops.desc: Check the ROPS mounts and both seat belts daily: wear, cuts, buckle works. Do not drill, weld or modify the ROPS. The canopy shown on the photo is an accessory.

windscreen.name: Windscreen (accessory)
windscreen.desc: Fold-down windscreen and mirrors are accessories on the photo; the club units may not have them. Clean with water and mild detergent only.

seat.name: Seats and hip restraints
seat.desc: GTX 1 and 2 (07043) have bucket seats. Seat belts checked daily. Note: 119-8474, listed in the old Notion manifest as the seat, is a decal and must not be ordered.

steering.name: Steering wheel and rack
steering.desc: Automotive-grade rack and pinion. Every 100 h: more than 13 mm free play at the wheel rim before the tyres move means check the steering shaft and rack joint, pinion seal, tie rods and ball joints. There is no OEM greasing task on the steering.

dash.name: Dash, display and telematics
dash.desc: Hour meter on the dash is the machine-hours source. Check the display for fault codes and battery level daily. Telematics gateway 161-9001 is listed for s/n 418xxxxxx (lithium) in catalogue 3471-384 only; the 419+ book (GTX 3 and 4) does not list it, but the 5 A telematics fuse is still shown. The distributor must activate it in Intelli360.

hood.name: Hood and front body
hood.desc: Lift the hood for the brake-fluid reservoir: check the level is above the MIN line daily (DOT 3). Never pressure wash near the controller, motor, batteries or dash.

lights.name: Headlights
lights.desc: Check both lights before working in low light. The headlight and tail-light numbers in the old Notion manifest (119-0240, 119-0242) are not in either GTX catalogue: look them up by serial.

guard.name: Brush guard (accessory)
guard.desc: Front brush guard shown on the photo is an accessory. Check the mounting bolts if it has taken a knock.

body.name: Side panel, seat base and floor
body.desc: Black side panels, seat base and floor step. Keep the step clear of mud and grass. Do not pressure wash: the drive electronics sit close behind the panels.

strut.name: Front strut (coil-over)
strut.desc: Front coil-over strut, 250 lb spring, 2 per vehicle. Check front suspension positioning and wheel alignment at the 100 h break-in, then camber and toe-in every 100 h or yearly: front tyres at 138 kPa (20 psi) and operator weight on the seat when checking.

brakes.name: Front disc brakes (calipers and pads)
brakes.desc: Hydraulic discs. Inspect every 100 h: pads under 1.6 mm = replace. Replace front and rear pads every 400 h (OM: dealer inspects). Avoid hard braking for the first several hours while new pads bed in. Caliper bolts 47-54 N.m.

tyreFR.name: Front tyre and wheel, right
tyreFR.desc: 22 x 9.5-12 4-ply, same tyre all four corners. 165-207 kPa (24-30 psi): lower end for light loads on turf, higher for heavy loads. Wheel nuts 108-122 N.m every 100 h. Check tyres and rims for damage every 100 h.

tyreFL.name: Front tyre and wheel, left
tyreFL.desc: 22 x 9.5-12 4-ply, same tyre all four corners. 165-207 kPa (24-30 psi). Wheel nuts 108-122 N.m every 100 h.

tyreRR.name: Rear tyre and wheel, right
tyreRR.desc: 22 x 9.5-12 4-ply, same as the front. 165-207 kPa (24-30 psi). Wheel nuts 108-122 N.m every 100 h.

hubs.name: Front wheel bearings and hub seals
hubs.desc: Every 300 h: remove hubs and rotors, clean and repack the bearings with Mobilgrease XHP-222. Bearing nut 15 N.m while rotating, then per the OM. New oil seal if damaged. Caliper bolts 47-54 N.m, wheel nuts 108-122 N.m on refit. 4 cones, 4 cups, 2 seals per vehicle.

brakesR.name: Rear brakes, park brake and master cylinder
brakesR.desc: Rear calipers carry the park brake (LH 140-2585, RH 140-2590). Park lever should come up tight within 11.4-16.5 cm of the P mark. To adjust (WO 1495, GTX 2): rear on stands, hold the adjusting post, loosen the jam nut 1/4 turn, wind the post in until it drags, back off 1/4 turn, lock; repeat other side. If it will not take up, the pads are worn. Brake fluid DOT 3, change every 1,000 h or 5 years (dealer job). Master cylinder on failure only.

shocksR.name: Rear shock and spring
shocksR.desc: Coil-over shock and spring, 2 per vehicle. The GTX has no rear leaf springs: 108-5770 in the old Notion manifest is wrong.

transaxle.name: Transaxle
transaxle.desc: SAE 10W-30, API SJ or higher, 0.66 L (lithium unit). Check the level every 100 h (level with the bottom of the fill plug, plug 20-27 N.m). Change every 800 h or yearly: drain via the cover (bolts 22-32 N.m), fill until it runs out of the fill hole. GTX 1 and 2: confirm the capacity in the 07043 manual.

motor.name: Drive motor (48 V AC)
motor.desc: Brushless AC induction motor, 5.0 kW continuous on the lithium unit. No routine service: listen for unusual noises and keep water away from it. 137-6936 is the 07433TC number; check by serial for GTX 1 and 2.

controller.name: Inverter / motor controller
controller.desc: 48 V, 185 A rms (Toro spec 540 A max with regen braking) on the 07433TC. Dealer diagnosis only. Never pressure wash near it. 145-5050 is the lithium-catalogue number; GTX 1 and 2 (07043) may differ.

dcdc.name: DC/DC converter (48 V to 12 V)
dcdc.desc: Runs the 12 V lights and accessories off the traction pack. 07433TC number shown; confirm by serial for GTX 1 and 2.

fuses.name: Fuses and main harness
fuses.desc: Keep a set on the shelf: 5 A 121-8864 and 117-4722, 10 A 121-8866 and 117-4724, 20 A 117-4726, 30 A 117-4728; machine power 200 A 122-2561. Telematics power fuse is 5 A. Numbers from the lithium catalogues.

batteryLi.name: Lithium battery pack (GTX 3 and 4, 07433TC only)
batteryLi.desc: LITHIUM UNITS ONLY. 2 x 145-5385 standard (3rd optional with Energy Expansion Kit 147-8220); plate 55 V nominal, 129.6 Ah. Sealed, no user servicing: do not open. Charge at 0-45 C only. Plug in at the end of each day; store more than 10 days at 40-60 % (50 % best), never at 100 %. Storage limits: -20 to 25 C up to 52 weeks, 25-45 C max 3 weeks, 45-55 C max 1 week. Yearly dealer health check if range drops. Old Notion number 04070 is not a part.

chargerLi.name: On-board charger 900 W (GTX 3 and 4, 07433TC only)
chargerLi.desc: LITHIUM UNITS ONLY. 100-240 VAC, 10 A max; will not charge outside 0-45 C (hot or cold battery icon on the display). Wipe the cord and case with a damp cloth after use, coil the cord, check for cuts. Leave the dielectric grease on the charger terminals. Charger fuse 30 A. Old Notion number 131-8490 is wrong.

batteryPb.name: Lead-acid battery pack (GTX 1 and 2, 07043 only)
batteryPb.desc: LEAD-ACID UNITS ONLY. The machinery bible has no 07043 battery part numbers: do NOT order the lithium 145-5385 for these. Look up the batteries by serial in the 07043 parts lookup (toro.com partdetails id 49614 and related). General flooded lead-acid practice, confirm in the 07043 operator manual: check electrolyte and top up with distilled water after charging, keep terminals clean and tight, never let the pack sit flat, ventilate when charging.

chargerPb.name: Battery charger (GTX 1 and 2, 07043 only)
chargerPb.desc: LEAD-ACID UNITS ONLY. The lithium on-board charger 144-5475 is not interchangeable with the lead-acid charger: look up the 07043 charger by serial. Charge after each day of use and check the cord and plug for damage.

161-9001.name: Telematics gateway (Intelli360)
161-9001.note: Listed for 07433TC s/n 418xxxxxx only. Activated by the Toro distributor.

140-2585.name: Rear brake caliper, LH (with park brake)

140-2590.name: Rear brake caliper, RH (with park brake)

136-6340.name: Transaxle assembly
136-6340.note: Major assembly. Dealer quote. Confirmed in catalogue 3471-384.

137-6936.name: Drive motor, 48 V AC
137-6936.note: Lithium (07433TC) number. Check by serial for 07043.

145-5050.name: Inverter / motor controller (48 V)
145-5050.note: Lithium (07433TC) number. Catalogue does not name Sevcon; old Notion 137-9898 is wrong.

140-2580: Toro dealer (Amacron / GA Power Equipment Spares / Emmetts)

model.note: Part outlines on the photo are drawn by hand and approximate. The photo is Toro's studio shot of the 07433TC lithium model with accessory canopy, windscreen, mirrors and brush guard. Part numbers come from the 07433TC lithium parts books 3471-384 and 3478-787 and operator's manuals 3471-379 / 3478-783. Batteries and charger differ: GTX 3 and 4 (07433TC) use lithium packs 145-5385 and the 900 W charger 144-5475; GTX 1 and 2 (07043) use a 48 V lead-acid pack and a different charger whose numbers are not in the bible, so look those up by serial and never order the lithium parts for them. Other numbers are from the lithium books: confirm by serial before ordering for GTX 1 and 2. Model-plate caveat: the bible records GTX 1 and 2 as s/n 418746774 and 418746776, which sit in the 07433TC lithium serial range, so read the plates on GTX 1 and 2 to confirm 07043.
